title: Main entrance approach
alt: A long sloping walkway behind a low wall crosses the Art Museum facade, with steps visible at the left and right.
caption: The front approach shows a long ramp behind a low wall and planting bed, alongside separate flights of steps.
author: EEJCC
limitations: Confirm which entrance is open, the drop-off route and the door controls before travelling.

title: Riverfront path surface
alt: A paved riverside path at Smale Riverfront Park, with grass on one side and a metal river railing on the other.
caption: A section of the riverfront path beside the Roebling Bridge shows the paved surface and its river-side railing.
author: w_lemay
limitations: This view does not show the connections between park levels. Confirm elevator operation and any flood or construction closures.

title: Shaker Trace Trail surface
alt: A paved section of Shaker Trace Trail with a yellow centre line, trees along the left edge and a grassy verge on the right.
caption: This section of Shaker Trace Trail shows the paved surface and an open grassy verge without a handrail.
author: Quadell
limitations: The photograph predates the resurfacing work described in the park notes. Confirm current surface condition, open sections and resting places.

title: Exterior ramp structure and benches
alt: A raised wooden ramp with railings runs beside the Ark, above a rock bed; a separate paved walkway with wooden benches follows the building below.
caption: A 2019 view shows the exterior ramp structure alongside the Ark and benches along the lower walkway. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
author: Cimerondagert
limitations: The ramp walking surface, doorway and connections from parking are outside this view. It does not establish slope, dimensions, a complete step-free route or current conditions.

title: Pavilion steps, garden paths and benches
alt: Looking down from the pavilion, stone steps with balustrades lead toward intersecting paved paths; benches line the path beside the Great Lawn.
caption: A September 2004 view from the pavilion shows the stair approach, garden paths and benches. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
author: Greg Hume
limitations: This historical view does not show a step-free alternative to the pavilion stairs, a route from parking, path gradients or current surface conditions. Small incidental visitors appear in the distance.

title: Historical main entrance doors
alt: Three glass doorways beneath a display race car at Jungle Jim’s; dark mats cover parts of the concrete approach and inside passage.
caption: A July 2004 photograph from the market’s own Flickr collection shows the Fairfield main entrance doors and mats. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
author: Jungle Jim's International Market
limitations: The door controls, opening widths and threshold heights are not established by this photograph. It does not show cart collection, designated parking or the complete arrival route. The entrance and displays may have changed since 2004.

title: Historical novelty restroom entrances
alt: Restroom entrances styled as portable toilets, labeled Women and Men with wheelchair symbols and No Carts Please signs; a green display stands between them.
caption: A December 2004 photograph from the market’s own Flickr collection shows the novelty restroom entrance facade. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
author: Jungle Jim's International Market
limitations: The wheelchair symbols are visible signage, not evidence of restroom dimensions or facilities. No interior fixtures, turning space, changing equipment or complete approach are shown. Current restroom layout and availability remain unverified.

title: Historical bison-route photo collage
alt: The creator’s collage has a gravel path beside a wire fence in the right panel, fence wires in the left panel and a wooden fence-post detail over the center.
caption: Janarude’s June 2010 photo collage shows one of the trails toward the bison enclosure. The creator’s complete collage, frames and lettering are retained; resized and converted to WebP.
author: Janarude
limitations: The source does not identify the named trail or exact segment. Only the right panel shows a short gravel path section; the collage does not show a continuous route, gradients, distance from parking or current conditions. Do not use it to identify a step-free route.

title: Concourse B corridor and restroom sign
alt: A broad polished-floor corridor under skylights in Concourse B; overhead signs list Gate B11 and restrooms, Gates B9–10, and Gate B12, with a few distant travelers facing away.
caption: A November 2025 view shows the Concourse B corridor near Gates B11 and B12, with overhead wayfinding and a restroom sign. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
author: Antony-22
limitations: The photograph does not show restroom interiors, changing equipment, elevator approaches or the complete route from the Terminal. It does not establish floor grip, distances, lighting at other times or current conditions.
